changelog:
## Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge)

### Fixes and Changes

- Added a small random rendering offset to bullet hole particles to reduce flickering when they overlap.
- Rotated cubes no longer get separate virtual groups, which may slightly improve performance.
- Fixed an issue where pressing the TaCZ Interact key triggered the use action twice when it shared a binding with Minecraft’s Use Item / Place Block action.
- Updated translations for several languages.
- Added a setting that slightly expands cubes in the `Ocular` group when loading scope models. This helps reduce flickering black spots on some scopes when lens effects are enabled.

### Default Gun Pack

- Adjusted the MCX Spear LT animations and the volume of the MRAD handling sounds. Fixed the SVD playing SKS firing sounds in third person.
- Corrected the muzzle flash and shell ejection positions on the AKM and RPK LOD models, along with the optic position on the RPK LOD model.
- Corrected the FMP13, QMK-152, and REAP-IR optic models. Updated the AMG 10 attachment slot icon and Pulsar XL50 texture.
- Expanded M16A1 optic compatibility and updated its dedicated optic tag.

name: [TaCZ] Timeless and Classics Zero 1.2.0 Forge mc1.20.1
changelog:
## New Content

### Guns

- Assault rifles: AK-12, AK-74M, H.C.A.R., MCX Spear LT, MK18, QR-24, and URGI.
- Pistols and SMGs: TEC-9 and MP7A1.
- Marksman rifles: SCAR-MK20 and Winchester M1866.
- Sniper rifles: SVD, MRAD, and HM50B.
- Shotguns and machine guns: M1897 "Trench Gun" and PKM.

### Attachments

- Added APM4s and 1P87 reflex sights.
- Added PSO-1, C79, Mark 4 ER/T, AMG 10, and Vintage Winchester Sharpshooter scopes.
- Added the XM157 Fire Control Optic.
- Added REAP-IR, FMP13, and Pulsar XL50 thermal sights.
- Added Magpul AFG and TROY angled grips.
- Added the NGAL laser.
- Added the SOCOM RC1 quick-detach suppressor.
- Added the CTR Heavy Stock and PSG Marksman Stock.
- Added low, mid, and high pistol risers, mid and high rail risers, and the Unity Riser.
- Added factory tactical, combat, HK, and AUG iron sights.
- Added two factory handguard covers.
- Added the M16A1 Assault Handguard.
- Added the M1897 Factory Bayonet.
- Added the M1866 Factory Artillery Barrel.
- Added options to unfold or remove factory stocks as built-in attachments.
- Added the Overpressure Recoil Shell ammo modification attachment.

### Ammo

- Added .300 BLK rifle ammo.

### Blocks

- Added Pegboards and Glow Pegboards with connections, corners, double-sided displays, dyeing, and placement previews.
- Added connectable, lockable Gun Display Cases.
- Added Iron, Gold, and Diamond Ammo Storage with large capacities, upgrades, portability, and quick transfers to and from ammo boxes.

## New Features

- Updated SnowStorm-based muzzle flash and smoke effects, with support for muzzle attachments to adjust their appearance.
- Firing now briefly illuminates the first-person hand model.
- Added new scope lens effects:
  - Configurable edge distortion, chromatic aberration, tinting, and vignetting.
  - Optional night vision and white-hot, black-hot, and ironbow thermal imaging modes.
- Added support for rangefinder displays on sights.
- Added ballistic impact prediction for fire-control optics.
- Added support for ammo counters on sights. The UH-1 is now a Smart Digital Sight.
- Built-in factory attachments can now be switched in the customization screen without consuming attachment items.
- Riser adapters can now be selected in the customization screen.
- Added ammo unloading, bound to `Alt + R` by default, along with related scripting APIs.
- Added configurable aiming transitions with custom ADS paths and FOV presets.
- Added recoil push with separate settings for standing, airborne, crouching, and prone positions.
- The M1866 now supports different action cycling speeds for hip fire and aiming.
- Added configurable surface impact effects and melee particles.
- Restored gunshot aggro: firing alerts nearby neutral mobs and attracts hostile mobs unless a suppressor is installed. This can be disabled in the config.
- Going prone no longer requires holding a gun.
- Prone pitch limits can now be configured.
- Gun data can now specify whether a weapon continues cooling while stored in the inventory, disabled by default. Enabled for the Minigun.
- Added a gun pack filter sidebar to Creative mode, with icons configurable in gun pack metadata.
- Added JEI queries for compatible gun attachments and ammo.
- Added JEI recipe transfer support, allowing selection of the corresponding workbench recipe.
- Added a TaCZ advancement tree covering crafting, customization, collecting, and shooting challenges.

## Optimizations and Fixes

- Added VBO acceleration, significantly improving rendering performance for third-person, dropped, and displayed guns.
- Optimized gun pack network synchronization with compression and chunking, fixing failures to join worlds with large numbers of gun packs.
- Optimized JEI initialization.
- Optimized inventory ammo counting and fixed the resulting issues with Minigun automatic fire.
- Updated models, textures, animations, and sounds for existing guns such as the M4A1 and AWP, as well as several sights.
- Added PBR textures for more guns, attachments, and shell casings.
- Added LOD models for more guns.
- Improved the default animation state machine and transitions, retaining the old state machine for third-party gun pack compatibility.
- Improved deployment and action cycling animations for built-in bipods.
- Reduced view obstruction by the gun when large sights are installed.
- Fixed incorrect bullet visibility in empty magazines and animations for guns such as the M700 and P320.
- Fixed the HK416 iron sight position.
- Fixed Vector model issues.
- Fixed RPG-7 animation issues.
- Attempted to fix cases where guns cannot fire after respawning or joining a server.
- Unified input handling so actions can be correctly bound to mouse buttons or keyboard keys and used with modifier keys.
- Fixed prone state being forcibly maintained and the "Hold to Crawl" option not working correctly.
- Improved Player Animator compatibility so mods that display a player model, such as paper doll mods, should now render correctly.
- Fixed misaligned rendering of armor on the hands from some mods under certain conditions.
- Fixed first-person sound positions drifting with player movement in some cases.
- Fixed offhand guns causing the main-hand walking bob to disappear.
- Fixed lighting on some item models in the inventory screen.
- Fixed emissive models rendering incorrectly with accelerated rendering.
- Fixed charging preventing interruption of round-by-round reloads.
- Unified gun animation and cooldown timing during game pauses. Animations and timers now stop advancing while the game is paused.
- Fixed workbenches producing item stacks above their stack limits.
- Fixed overlapping hide-chart buttons in the customization screen.
- Fixed the gun HUD appearing in Spectator mode.
- Fixed headshot hitboxes appearing when reduced debug information is enabled.
- Improved server-side script error handling to prevent script errors from crashing the server.
- Fixed invalid fire modes throwing exceptions that could crash the client.
- Fixed rare client crashes caused by projectiles spawned by other sources with null resource IDs.
- Fixed empty sound or particle keyframes causing animation loading to fail.
- Improved animation constraint handling by taking absolute values first, ensuring compatibility with Blockbench 5 keyframes.
- Corrected event triggering for firing, reload completion, and drawing guns.

## Other Changes

- Rebalanced various existing guns and attachments.
- Added a Marksman Rifle category and moved the MK14, Tactical SKS, and SPR-15HB into it.
- Adjusted slide restrictions for some guns.
- Guns can now configure whether reloading or cycling the action forces the player out of aiming.
- Workbench and Creative mode items are now grouped and sorted by namespace.
- Adjusted the display order of ammo and attachments.
- Built-in factory attachments are now labeled and pinned to the top of the customization list.
- Added sight tooltips for rangefinding, fire control, thermal imaging, and ammo counters.
- Added ingredient item tooltips to workbenches.
- Improved workbench hints for filtering by the held item.
- Updated some attachment icons.
- Added a crafting recipe for the Taurus 943.
- Removed recipes for four older raised pistol sights.
- Added an option to use hip-fire spread while airborne.
- Added an option for bullets to pass through teammates when friendly fire is disabled.
- Added a configurable list of entity types ignored by bullet damage.
- The list of blocks bullets can destroy is now customizable, with a hardness limit.
- Added a muzzle smoke toggle.
- Added hit particle toggles and a display distance setting.
- Added toggles for scope lens effects and thermal imaging.
- Added an option to hide third-person guns in the offhand and unselected hotbar slots.
- Added a held-gun damage tilt strength setting.
- Sounds now support custom volume, pitch, random variation, and references to vanilla sounds.
- Some animations now support particle keyframes, limited to the muzzle position; locators are not supported.
- Improved default gun pack update detection.
- Clarified the default gun pack debug setting description.
- Updated the default gun pack icon.
- Updated translations.

name: [TaCZ] Timeless and Classics Zero 1.1.8
changelog:
# tacz-1.20.1-1.1.8

## New Content

### Guns
- .357 Rhino Revolver
- .30-06 Lonetrail Hand Cannon
- .22 Modle 943 Revolver
- Mauser KAR98K Standard Rifle
- MK23 Offensive Handgun
- Taurus "Raging Hunter" Hand Cannon
- M9A4

### Attachments
- Mauser 4x Light Sight
- Wraith Silencer
- PEQ6 ILLM (Exclusive to the MK23 Offensive Handgun)

### Ammos
- 8mm Mauser Bullet
- .22 Winchester Magnum
- .500 Magnum

### Ammunition Models
Updated textures for the existing ammunition models and added a large number of new ammo models. Additionally, the positioning groups for bullet models have been reworked to prevent clipping issues when placed in display frames.

---

## Features

### Charge-Up / Trigger Delay
It is now possible to configure independent charge-up behaviors for different firing modes in the data files, along with corresponding logic machine/state machine methods. As part of this feature, the logic machine can now also apply temporary bonus damage and projectile velocity multipliers to the current shot.

### Loot Table Injection
Added a simple loot table injector. It is now possible to inject desired items directly into the game's loot tables. Usage examples can be found in the default pack under `tacz_loot_injectors`.

### Other Features
- Ammo Sorting: Ammunition can now be sorted just like firearms and attachments. The default pack ammunition order has also been reorganized.
- Attachment-Controlled Mount Rendering: Attachments can now determine whether the firearm’s built-in mount should be rendered when a sight is installed via the attachment display settings.

---

## Adjustments & Optimizations

### Resource Loading
Optimized the resource loading strategy. Memory usage and loading speed should now be significantly improved when loading large numbers of gun packs.

- Adjusted firearm sound playback to use the same asynchronous & lazy-loading method as vanilla Minecraft.
- All official pack assets except sound files are now fully preloaded.
- Assets from other gun packs (models/animations) are now loaded on demand.
- All resources for a firearm are proactively loaded when the weapon is drawn.
- The game periodically scans firearms in the inventory and attempts to preload their resources in the background.
- Optimized the default pack export logic. Now it will perfer to compare metadata first, so startup speed after the first launch should now be noticeably faster

This feature can be disabled in the configuration. Disabling it will revert to full preloading.

### Ammunition Workbench
Reorganized the ammunition category tabs in the TaCZ Ammunition Assembly Workbench GUI into six major categories:

- "Personal Defense Ammunition"
- "Intermediate / Full-Power Rifle Ammunition"
- "Large-Caliber Specialized Ammunition"
- "Explosives & Projectiles"
- "Shotgun Ammunition"
- "Unconventional Projectiles"

This makes it easier for players to locate the ammunition they need. All ammunition slot textures have also been updated to match their category colors. The generic "Ammunition" tab has been retained to prevent crafting issues with some addon packs.

### Other Adjustments
- If the "Bonus Chest" option is enabled when creating a world, it will now contain a Model 943 Revolver and ammunition.
- Simultaneous playback limits for duplicate sound effects are now adjusted separately depending on the scenario. The limits can be configured in the settings.
- When opening the Gunsmith Workbench while holding a firearm, the "Filter by Held Item" option is now enabled by default for easier attachment/ammo searching. This can be toggled in the configuration menu.
- Updated `gunpack_info` version number -> `1.1.8`
- Adjusted the positioning groups for some firearm rails to align uniformly with the rail surface.
- Updated the slot textures for the MP5A5 Submachine Gun and Vector Submachine Gun.
- Improved firing animations for the M134 Minigun.
- Improved firing animations for the HK-416A5 Assault Rifle.
- Adjusted handling and stats for the M1911 Pistol.
- Updated the model for the RPK Light Machine Gun.
- Updated the extended magazine model and corresponding reload animations for the SCAR-H Battle Rifle.
- Updated the AUG Assault Rifle model and attachment slots. It can now equip additional optics.
- Adjusted ADS FOV, magnification levels, and reticle styles for all `sight`-type optics. ADS transitions are now more nonlinear, and reticles now use a 45-degree angled plate design to prevent dimming.
- Adjusted magnification levels for some pistol optics to improve sight visibility.
- Updated the model for the TA31 2x Advanced Combat Optical Sight.
- Updated slot textures for some optics.
- Adjusted slug ammunition attachment properties: all accuracy bonuses now significantly improve aiming precision.

- Buffed the M134 Minigun: improved cooling efficiency and reduced overheating likelihood.
- Slightly increased the accuracy of the M1014 Combat Shotgun.
- Nerfed the SPAS-12 Multifunction Shotgun’s semi-auto mode accuracy and armor penetration.

- Restored the M16A4 Standard Rifle's "old school" style (?).

---

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue causing model/animation assets to consume excessive memory.
- Fixed a potential memory leak caused by sound playback.
- Fixed a potential configuration synchronization issue.
- Fixed an issue where optic mask rendering order became incorrect when using performance rendering mods.
- Fixed animation issues when the M107 .50 Anti-Materiel Rifle was equipped with extended magazine attachments.
- Attempted to mitigate an issue where playing large numbers of sound effects could cause the game to stop outputting audio.

name: [TaCZ] Timeless and Classics Zero 1.1.5
changelog:
## Important Notice  
- Reminder: If your game fails to launch, please first check or try updating any tacz add-on mods or other linked mods. These mods often use mixin to implement certain features. If they are not updated to be compatible with the latest version of tacz, any change to injection points can lead to injection failure and cause the game to crash.

## New Features  

### Laser System Update  
- Added "Laser" type attachments and corresponding slots.  
- Added a new model positioning group `laser_beam`, compatible with any type of attachment or gun.  
- Added laser-related settings in the display configuration.  
- If the item has the color editing option enabled, laser color can be customized in the modification interface by selecting the appropriate attachment.

### Sight Function Update  
- Added combination sights feature: multiple `view` positions can be set for a single sight and switched between.  
- Added ammo count text display feature, including in-sight display support.

### Overheat Update  
- Added overheat mechanics for guns. Refer to comments in the data files for Minigun and AK47 for specific parameters.  
- Overheat behavior can be controlled via Lua scripts.

### Gun Smith Table Optimization  
- In Creative Mode, crafting items no longer consumes materials.  
- Added a filter panel with support for:
  - Filtering by gun pack  
  - Searching by product name  
  - Searching by held item (e.g., searching with a gun matches compatible attachments and ammo, and vice versa)  
- Gun packs now support custom recipe categories and icons within the workbench.  
- Two new workbench models added to the default pack; attachments and ammunition are now placed in these new workbenches.  
- Default recipe filters in the workbench can now be disabled via `EnableDefaultGunSmithTableFilter` in the `serverconfig` (located in `serverconfig/tacz-server.toml` under your world save directory; can also be set globally via `defaultconfigs`).

### Other Features  
- When crouching and aiming, players can now tilt-hold weapons.  
- Added attachment parameters for tilted weapon handling.  
- Server-side Lua scripts can now customize bullet spread patterns.  
- Added two debug options (see next item).  
- Added command: `/tacz config <key> <true/false>` to configure some `serverconfig` options in-game:
  - `defaultTableLimit`: Enable/disable default workbench recipe restrictions.  
  - `serverShootNetworkCheck`: Debug option. Enable/disable server shooting network validation. If you cannot shoot at all in certain environments, try disabling this.  
  - `serverShootCooldownCheck`: Debug option. Enable/disable server shooting cooldown validation.  
    - **Warning**: Disabling this will stop the server from calculating gun cooldowns entirely, which may lead to potential cheating. Only disable if you cannot shoot at all and disabling `serverShootNetworkCheck` doesn't help.

## New Content  

### New guns  
- Added G36k, Minigun, SPR15hb, B93R, and Springfield 1873 bolt-action rifle.

### New Attachments  
**Sights**:  
- OKP-7 Reflex Sight  
- FastFire Reflex Sight  
- FastFire Elevated Reflex Sight  
- ACRO P-1 Reflex Sight  
- ACRO P-1 Elevated Reflex Sight  
- DeltaPoint Reflex Sight  
- DeltaPoint Elevated Reflex Sight  
- SRS-02 Reflex Sight  
- PK06 Reflex Sight  
- PK06 Elevated Reflex Sight  
- Voodoo 1-6x Hybrid Precision Scope  
- HAMR 3x Hybrid Optic  
- Mark 5 HD 5-25x Hybrid Scope  
- Vintage Springfield Sharpshooter Scope  
- Contender 4x Scope

**Grips**:  
- SI Angled Stop  
- RK-6 Light Foregrip  
- RK-0 Vertical Grip  
- P-2 Tactical Vertical Grip  
- RK-1 Angled Grip  
- SE-5 Angled Grip  
- TD Skeleton Angled Grip

**Stocks**:  
- Izhmash Tactical Stock  
- MOE Lightweight Stock  
- SBA3 Stock  
- KS Tactical Stock  
- M4SS Tactical Stock  
- RS Ultra-Lightweight Stock

**Lasers**:  
- Militech Compact Laser  
- Lopro Tactical Laser  
- Nightstick Compact Laser  

## Fixes & Optimizations  
- Refactored parts of the first-person animation model and animation state machine in preparation for future non-gun items.  
- Added fire mode animations and state machines for some guns.  
- Adjusted min/max values and display style of the stats chart; it now shows "calculated result (±change)".  
- Improved the appearance of first-person tracer rounds.  
- Fixed an issue causing LOD to not eject shells.  
- Completed laser positioning groups for some guns.  
- Improved transition visuals when changing magnification on scopes.  
- Reduced recoil suppression for high-magnification scopes.  
- Added support for setting default animations.  
- Replaced the model asset for the "Stannard 5-10x Optic" and renamed it to "Scout 4-10x Optic".  
- Fixed a bug where gun constraints would behave abnormally when the gun was tilted.
- Fixed several asset-related issues.
- Added error handling to avoid crashes or chain reactions caused by misconfigured gun packs in certain cases.
- Fixed a bug where state machines would be incorrectly re-initialized under certain conditions.
- Fixed an issue where custom gun workbench recipes weren't fully visible in JEI.
- Fixed a bug where bullet entities did not carry the correct displayId.

name: [TaCZ] Timeless and Classics Zero 1.1.4
changelog:
1.1.4 Release:        
**Major Version Content:**
1. Gun Pack File Structure Upgrade:
// The old version of the gun pack needs to be converted before it can be used in the new mod version (the game will prompt for conversion and provide a quick conversion function).
// The new gun pack is in the .minecraft/tacz directory.
// The new gun pack can utilize all the resource and data pack' features.
// Extremely optimized the loading speed of gun pack resources and world entry.
// PBR (Physically Based Rendering) support has been restored under the Optifine environment.
// You can add recipes from the original game or other mods, or customize them using mods like KubeJS.
2. New Client-side Animation State Machine and Server-side Basic Gun Logic Scripts:
// You can now modify gun animation state machines through Lua scripts, and make some basic customizations to the server-side gun logic.
// The default gun pack provides several example scripts, including one for pump loading, as a reference.        
        
**Add:**
1. Added new weapons: M107 Anti-material Rifle, M700 Sniper Rifle, M1911 Pistol, P90 Submachine Gun, QBZ95 Assault Rifle, TYPE81 Assault Rifle, M870 Shotgun.
2. Added a command to automatically convert compressed gun packs from the old gun pack directory into the new structure and move them to the new directory.
// Every time you enter the world, a prompt will be shown if the old directory contains content.
// Gun packs in the folder do not support automatic conversion, please compress them first.
3. Added custom crafting table functionality, allowing you to add custom crafting table appearances to gun packs. Three preset collision boxes are available.
4. Added a button to open the new gun pack folder in the gun refit screen.
5. Added the ability to modify specific crafting recipes within a crafting table using recipe filters, with support for regular expressions.
6. Added a gun display option that lets you display the damage tooltip of a gun as "single bullet damage x total bullet amount."
7. Added a configuration option to show the IDs of guns, ammo, and attachments when enabling the advanced tooltips (F3 + H).        
        
**Fix:**
1. Fixed a crash related to audio playback when quickly switching guns (CME error).
2. Fixed a bug where models modified by other mods (e.g., Mek, Create) would cause misalignment of the first-person hand-held armor when holding a gun.
3. Fixed a sound issue when switching audio devices, causing audio distortion.
// From https://github.com/TartaricAcid/TouhouLittleMaid/pull/574
4. Fixed a bug where bullet hole particles would float in the air when hitting invalid blocks.
// Thanks to SNWCreations, https://github.com/MCModderAnchor/TACZ/pull/291
5. Fixed a group server issue that might happened to crash.
6. Fixed a FOV scale issue that happened under spectator mode.        
        
**Adjust:**
1. Adjusted recoil curves for some guns to improve the sense of impact.
2. Adjusted the aiming sight behavior of some guns to provide a better field of view.
3. Updated some gun sound effects.
4. Updated kill sound effects.
5. Third-person sound effects will now be forced to play in mono to avoid losing spatial audio effects.
6. No longer using mixin for lang, which may help fix some mod compatibility issues.
7. The old server-side gun pack functionality has been temporarily removed. You can use the original server resource pack functionality instead, which only requires placing the contents in the assets folder.
8. The sort setting number now sorts attachments.        
        
**Attention:**
1. The deprecated API methods for the old default gun pack have been removed. Mod authors who used these methods should migrate to the new methods after updating the built-in package format.

name: [TaCZ] Timeless and Classics Zero 1.0.3
changelog:
1.0.3 Release:    
**Add:**
1. Add LOD assets for M16A4.
2. Add SCAR-L assault rifle, M320 grenade launcher, HK416D assault rifle, MK14 DMR, P320 pistol, AUG assault rifle, and its default sights (as a sample for using default attachment).
3. Add functionality to add NBT data for bullets, guns, and attachments during crafting.
4. Add two grip attachments.
5. Add Controllable Mod support, enabling gun control with a controller. Controller button prompts are also supported (button prompts are limited to versions 1.18 and 1.19).
6. Add crawling capabilities (can be disabled via Config file), providing a more stable shooting posture.
7. Add three new suppressor muzzle attachments.
8. Add fire mode control for gun data.
9. Add vibration feedback when using a game controller (version 1.20.1 only).
10. Add a new weapon attachment data system with multiple configurable items.
11. Add a feature to back up gun pack files before overwriting.
12. Add a version-checking feature.
13. Add a mechanism to control damage types via tags (version 1.20.1 only).
14. Add a data configuration for block destruction by explosions.
15. Add an accessory attribute for block destruction by explosions.
16. Add gun data for recoil reduction while crawling.
17. Add a default attachment feature (e.g., for AUG).
18. Add a feature to hide attachments in the Creative Mode inventory.
19. Add a weight system that affects player movement speed.
20. Add a configuration option to disable FOV changes based on movement speed when holding a weapon.
21. Add ammo plugins.
22. Add a feature to display the current ammo count as a percentage.
23. Add a feature that allows refilling the entire capacity by consuming a single ammo item.
24. Add a feature to display the crafting count in the gun workbench.

**Fix:**
1. Fix an issue with abnormal horizontal recoil behavior.
2. Fix flaws in the M16A1 LOD model.
3. Fix the issue where defaultDisplay was null.
4. Fix errors when attaching the guns’ recipes in versions 1.18 and 1.19.
5. Fix the issue of ignoring blocks in melee combat;
6. Fix an issue with inaccuracy values being called during moving.
7. Fix the position of the third-person model.
8. Fix some compatibility issues with Optifine.
9. Fix some compatibility issues with Oculus.
10. Fix texture errors with RPG7 LOD.
11. Fix an issue where Ender Dragon was injured incorrectly.
12. Fix abnormal playback of offhand weapon switch animation;
13. Fix dummy ammo unload error while changing the magazine;

**Adjust:**
1. Adjust the manufacturing settings of some weapons to have the factory stock initially.
2. Limit gun text prompts to a maximum of three lines, each 300px wide.
3. Readjust gun recoil settings.
4. Make explosive knockback affected by both damage and radius.
5. Adjust the sneaking walk animation.
6. Enhance bullet gravity performance.
7. Remove the design of bullet close-range damage.
8. The refit screen will now display the effective range.
9. The refit screen will now display the current fire mode.
10. The refit screen will now have a foldable button for value display.
11. Tracer will now appear closer to the muzzle than the eye position.
12. Allow extending EntityKineticBullet.
13. Adapt attachments for PBR.
14. Replace hardcoded bullet penetration controls with tags.
15. The value display screen will now allow switching fire modes.
16. Supplement a lot of attachment tags for gun pack integration.
